title: GRADIUS 1985 | Stage 1 Volcano
originalBrief: Reconstruct the gameplay of Gradius Arcade 1985 Stage 1 through the end of the twin-volcano sequence, preserving verified original terrain, turret/hatch anchors, wave timing, routes and mechanics. Produce original upgraded art and sprite animations. Do not use original graphics. End before original Big Core; user-approved alternative: stationary two-peak mountain as one boss with two MLB_Gravitation emitters. Build only after exact source-coordinate measurements. Use existing Level Builder V6, Reverse Wave Authoring and Play QA.

gaps.description: Validate existing sprites, profile and animations before any level recipe.
Verify existing volcano crater system can eject timed destructible rocks.
Verify two launcher types and prefab-relative launch origin.
Unity has an unsaved SCENE_Cutscene_Workshop modal. Do not dismiss or overwrite other scene.
Exact original arcade map and turret/hatch coordinates have not been measured; map metadata only.
Enemy wave spawn timestamps and paths require frame-by-frame measurement.
Build single stationary two-peak mountain boss with two MLB_Gravitation emitters; original Big Core is not required.

decisions.reference: User explicitly required designer agent finish all graphics/prefabs/bosses before automated Level Builder JSON.
decisions.description: Preflight asset readiness gates Level Builder; split ownership between game-asset and JSON generation agents.

lastCompletedAction: Created and inspected new stationary two-peak Gradius volcano boss prefab, 2 autotrigger gravitation weapons, Plastic MAIN cs9526, no Play QA yet.
nextAction: Run isolated Play Mode check of GRADIUS_VOLCANO_MOUNTAIN_BOSS, test actual gravity projectiles and health; separately finish CUTE/HATCH animation QA. Integrate source agent coordinates only once measured.
